# Tactical Translation Matrix

| Strategic priority | Tactical action | Owner | Alignment score | Execution readiness | Feedback source | Review trigger |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| [Priority] | [Action] | [Owner] | [0-1] | [0-1] | [Source] | [Trigger] |

## Review questions

- Does each tactic clearly serve a strategic priority?
- Does each tactic have a decision owner?
- Does each tactic generate usable feedback?
- Does the feedback route to tactics, strategy, ideation, learning, or legitimacy review?
- Which tactics are activity without strategic link?
